notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing an creature, which is an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
When the creature dies, Fain triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token that is an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Repeat.
